title:
Among the bad superheroes, what is the percentage of female superheroes?
Be
question:
Among the bad superheroes, what is the percentage of female superheroes?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: bad superheroes refers to alignment.id = 2; percentage = MULTIPLY(DIVIDE(SUM(gender.id = 2 WHERE alignment.id = 2), COUNT(alignment.id = 2)), 100.0); female refers to gender.id = 2;

prediction.sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.XCL_008 = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.XCL_021 = T2.XCL_007
JOIN alignment AS T3 ON T1.XCL_027 = T3.XCL_001
WHERE T3.XCL_002 = 'Bad'
